ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Program Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate allegations of fraud in child care programs, including the Minnesota program, to determine the extent of wrongdoing and identify potential perpetrators.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: What is the scope of child care program fraud in Minnesota?
Who are the key players involved in the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This investigation could uncover significant wrongdoing and lead to accountability for those involved. By analyzing data and reviewing public records, we may be able to identify patterns and connections between entities that can inform future investigations.
